verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage documents its own Export API, which creates date-ranged exports across customers, screenings, screening/monitoring cases, profiles, payment-screening cases, transaction-monitoring cases/alerts and transactions. Transaction data is explicitly exportable as CSV, and per-case audit trails are retrievable via API. However, the file format is only stated for transactions, the download URL expires after 5 seconds, and nothing shows that everything (configurations, risk-scoring settings, users/roles) can be exported or that account closure or data deletion is supported. Missing for 10: documented open formats for all export types, evidence of complete account-wide export including configurations, an offboarding or data-deletion process, and independent or hands-on corroboration of exports.
